title: Research memos and concept notes

voice.rule: "the Firm", never "we", "our" or "us" (PTQ15.4: the Firm 2, we 0).

defined_terms.pointer_formula: has the meaning ascribed thereto in [●];
defined_terms.lead_in: Unless otherwise defined in this Memorandum, capitalised terms used hereunder shall bear the meanings ascribed thereto in the Reviewed Documents (defined below):
defined_terms.rule: Glossary entries: the term in bold, then "means …;" or "has the meaning ascribed thereto in …;"; in the body (the X) bold without quotation marks.

cross_refs.rule: Section 3 (Brief Answer), Annexure A (Detailed Analysis); the reviewed documents' own provisions are cited by their own words (Clause 3.1 of the [●]).

headings.rule: Title Case with small words capitalised (Transaction Background And Query); annexure headings with an en dash: Annexure A – Detailed Analysis.

cover.text: Memorandum On [●] / Dated: [●] / Prepared For: / Prepared By: / Table Of Contents

structure.text: 1 Glossary; 2 Transaction Background And Query (2.1 Transaction Background, 2.2 Reviewed Documents, 2.3 Query); 3 Brief Answer; Annexure A – [title chosen for the subject]. There is usually no Annexure B or C; when there is, B reproduces the contract or document provision and C the law.

reviewed.text: For the purposes of this Memorandum, the Firm has reviewed [●] (the [●]), [●] and [●] (together, the Reviewed Documents).

query.text: The query framed for the purposes of this Memorandum (the Query) is as follows:

pointer_to_answer.text: For a brief answer to the Query, please refer to Section 3 (Brief Answer) below.

annexure_open.text: This Annexure A ([●]) sets out, for each provision identified in Section 3 (Brief Answer), …

disclaimer.text: Disclaimer: This ‘[●]’ (this Memorandum) dated [●], has been prepared by Ali Khan Law Associates (the Firm) for [●]. This Memorandum reflects the Firm’s current understanding based on the limited documents provided and it is not exhaustive and does not constitute complete advice … The Firm disclaims all liability for reliance on this Memorandum …

page_end.text: [***The Rest Of This Page Has Been Intentionally Left Blank***]

notes: No sign-off: the memo ends with its last section and the page-end line.
